Know exactly what is included.

Test checkout and prices

Checklist: ₹999. Aggrieved Woman Advanced Guide: ₹1,999 for 90 days. Respondent Advanced Guide: ₹1,999 for 90 days. These are the displayed catalogue totals; no additional charge is collected in this test release.

Real payments are disabled. A test order charges ₹0, creates no tax invoice, paid contract or real subscription, and cannot be used as proof of purchase. It grants test delivery. Individual guide test access is saved to your account. Saved local recovery files stay on your device.

What you receive

The 84-Point IC/LC Legal Checklist is an online, organisation-licensed working review with eight domains, eight report-finalisation gates and conditional legal pathways, current edition 4.0 dated 11 November 2026. One organisation may access the current edition for 120 days from verified payment capture. Coded review responses stay in the current browser tab until exported as JSON or an editable Word document; no automatic cloud saving or case storage is provided. Future editions are separate.

Each individual guide is self-service software with eight role-specific stages, nine editable Word drafts, a local next-action planner and recovery files, available to one account for 90 days from activation. Downloaded worksheets remain available for your own preparation. No shared logins, resale or public redistribution. These products do not include IC/LC workspace access.

Limits and responsibilities

No consultation, personal document review, legal representation, appointment, filing, Committee contact or outcome guarantee is included. Downloading does not issue, serve or approve a document. Review placeholders and actual facts offline before use. Software does not determine credibility, guilt, limitation, jurisdiction or an appeal outcome.

Verify applicable law, service/sector rules and actual directions. Personal review dates are not statutory deadline calculations. Training, Committee composition and institutional duties remain applicable.

Privacy, saving and recovery

Only account and product-access checks go to the account service. Guide selections and personal review dates remain in the open tab, with no automatic save. Do not enter identities, evidence or testimony. Download a local recovery file and verify restoration before relying on it. Store files securely; they are not encrypted by Navigator and are not an institutional audit log.

Checklist test orders are linked to the buyer account so the personalised file can be downloaded again within the test access period. Individual guide test access lasts 90 days from activation and survives service restarts. Keep case information out of order fields.

Renewals, delivery problems and support

No automatic renewal or recurring billing. At expiry, review the current scope and price before any new activation; saved files remain on your device. Save recovery before leaving a guide. You can start a new ₹0 test checkout for an individual guide after its access ends. For online Inquiry Checklist or Compliance Checklist access, sign in with the original buyer account.

For a missing download, unavailable access or an incorrect product, contact training@thecosmicenergizers.com with the product, test reference and a brief technical description. Do not send case documents or passwords. No paid refund can arise while no money is collected. Before real sales open, purchase confirmation, taxes, cancellation/refund handling and durable paid entitlements must be enabled and checked. Nothing here excludes mandatory consumer rights.
